hero.subtitle: Products, stock, orders, invoices and returns - all in one place, with the right access for every role on your team.

feature.heading: Everything Your Operation Needs
feature.subheading: A complete toolkit for your catalog, stock, order flow, billing and back-office operations.
feature.catalog_description: Model products, variants, options and bundles, with availability windows, VAT rates by country and live stock levels on the storefront.
feature.stock_description: Receive goods into FIFO lots at a weighted-average cost, reserve stock as orders are placed, adjust it by hand with a reason and get low-stock alerts.
feature.orders_description: Follow an order from cart to delivery, with discounts, a checkout split across warehouses and numbered documents from a shared series.
feature.billing_description: Typed invoices with full or partial reversals, payments allocated oldest-first and a ledger of what every client owes.
feature.returns_description: Buyers request a return within the window, operators approve it, and the goods re-enter stock by condition while a refund is drafted.
feature.content_description: Publish articles with scheduling, and collect comments, ratings and reviews with automatic flagging of reported content.
feature.directory_description: Keep a shared directory of clients, vendors, brands and addresses across the whole team.
feature.permissions_description: Grant per-entity, per-operation access so admins and operators only see what they need.
feature.dashboard_description: Every entity - users, logs, mail queue, templates - managed from a single, consistent CRUD interface.

cta.back_description: Jump into the admin dashboard to manage users, catalog, orders and more.
cta.ready_description: Create an account to manage your catalog, orders and team in one dashboard.
